description: View and control the spending limits of your MPP32 agent session. 'get' = current budget status (remaining budget, hourly velocity, paused / circuit-breaker state). 'set' = configure limits (budget cap in USD, hourly velocity limit, alert threshold). 'pause' = immediately stop all paid calls (safe to use any time). 'resume' = lift a pause, and 'reset' = clear a tripped circuit breaker — ONLY use 'resume' or 'reset' when the human operator explicitly asks you to; never on your own to get past a limit, because the breaker exists to stop runaway agent spending.

action.description: 'get' = view status, 'set' = update limits, 'pause' = stop paid calls, 'resume' = lift a pause (human operator request only), 'reset' = clear a tripped circuit breaker (human operator request only).

alertThresholdPercent.description: Budget percentage at which to warn (e.g. 80 = warn at 80% spent). Only used with action='set'.

budgetLimitUsd.description: Maximum total session spend in USD. Only used with action='set'.

velocityLimitUsd.description: Maximum spend per hour in USD. Only used with action='set'.

name: manage_agent_budget
